v201_source_url_gap_policy.principle: Do not fake source URLs. Add verified source landing pages where available; otherwise keep source_url blank and mark source_discovery_needed with a query hint. Store counts remain in the unified retail_presence master.

v202_source_discovery_gap_reduction_poli.purpose: Reduce source_url discovery gaps without inserting fake URLs; add usable official/semi-official/reference source URLs to the unified retail_presence master.
v202_source_discovery_gap_reduction_poli.auto_update_policy: all retail presence records remain auto_update_enabled=true and update_frequency=quarterly
v202_source_discovery_gap_reduction_poli.safety_rule: Weak or unmatched URLs remain source_discovery_needed; no placeholder/fake URLs added.

v203_source_discovery_hold_policy.purpose: Do not attach weak or mismatched URLs to the remaining unresolved source-discovery records. Move them to manual source review while keeping quarterly auto-update metadata active.
v203_source_discovery_hold_policy.rule: No fake source URLs; no weak travel/social/listing pages as auto-update source unless the page is clearly the same retailer and usable for store-count refresh.

v204_storecount_holefill_priority_policy.purpose: Classify remaining store-count gaps by source readiness and country priority so the next hole-fill work does not scatter into separate lists.
v204_storecount_holefill_priority_policy.auto_update_policy: all retail presence records remain auto_update_enabled=true and update_frequency=quarterly
